verdict.rationale: Muse offers an audit trail of actions (muse-docs-13, muse-docs-8) and VM data that is continuously backed up and can be restored (muse-supp-vm-files-export), plus approval cards before actions execute (muse-docs-10), which cover some review/rollback needs. However there's no evidence of explicit versioning of automations/goals themselves or a rollback mechanism specific to an automation's logic rather than general VM state restore. Missing for 10: explicit automation/version history, ability to roll back a specific automation to a prior version, structured review workflow beyond pre-action approval.
